idea-plugin.name: Phantom Icon Pack
idea-plugin.description: Colored file and folder icons by name and extension, drawn from the Material Icon Theme by Philipp Kief (MIT). Java files show the Java cup and Kotlin files the Kotlin logo, also where the file is shown as the class it declares (Project view, navigation bar, editor tabs); Java classes show Material icons by kind (class, abstract class, interface, enum, record, annotation, exception). Source, test and resource roots get their own folder colors. Only the icons of files on screen are loaded. Turn the plugin off to get the platform icons back.
